newsitem.title: USA: OraVax Inc approves rights plan.
newsitem.headline: OraVax Inc approves rights plan.

text.p: OraVax Inc said on Friday that its board of directors had approved the adoption of a shareholder rights plan to deter coercive or unfair takeover tactics.

The preferred stock purchase rights will be distributed on April 15, 1997 as a dividend at the rate of one right for each share of OraVax outstanding as of the close of business on that date, the company said.

The rights will be exercisable only if a person or group has acquired beneficial ownership of 20 percent or more of OraVax's common stock or announces a tender or exchange offer that would result in a person or group owning 30 percent of the company's common stock, OraVax said.
The rights will expire on April 17, 2007 unless earlier redeemed, exchanged or terminated, OraVax said.
OraVax said the rights plan will not restrict the company's ability to consider a takeover offer on favorable terms.
